explanations.2: This line sets up a rule system where Apache will first check deny rules, then check allow rules, in that order.
explanations.3: This blocks access from everyone by default.
explanations.4: This then opens access back up specifically for that IP address, overriding the deny-all rule above it.
explanations.7: This is the newer Apache 2.4 way to deny everyone access to this directory or file.
explanations.8: This is the newer Apache 2.4 way to allow only that specific IP address through, replacing the older Order/Allow syntax.
